about: Seconds per test, serial (-n 0), slow tests included, on the owner's 12-core dev machine. Per test file: each test of 0.5 s or more by name, the rest as [count, total s]. Tests that build toy maps (tests/replays/control_toys.py) may hold cold-cache times, far above a warm run's. Refresh: python scripts/test_timings.py refresh <junit.xml>. A machine under load runs up to ~2x these.
